target.title: fix(agent): classify stuck recovery as idle timeout
target.body:
## Summary

- Problem: Fixes #93610. Diagnostic stuck-session recovery aborted active embedded runs with the same downstream semantics as user/restart/superseded aborts, so failover could see `external_abort` and surface `Request was aborted` instead of using the configured idle-timeout fallback path.
- Why it matters / User impact: Cron/provider sessions that stall while a model call is actively in flight can still use the existing idle-timeout rotate/fallback path, while stale post-model recoveries and side-effecting tool stalls stay out of replay paths.
- Solution: Preserve `stuck_recovery` through diagnostic abort/drain and reply-run propagation, then classify replay safety from active model-call state and active potential-side-effect tool state before failover observes abort semantics.
- Current-head refresh: merged current `origin/main`, resolved the doctor health contribution test mock conflict, and re-ran production-module runtime proof plus focused tests on the new PR head.
- Fixes #93610

## What Problem This Solves

Diagnostic stuck-session recovery needs different downstream semantics depending on what was active when recovery fired. A stalled model call can safely use the existing idle-timeout fallback path; an active potential-side-effect tool call must not be replayed; stale or unknown recovery should remain external-abort-like.

## User Impact

Users running scheduled or provider-backed embedded-agent sessions get a safer recovery path when the stuck-session watchdog interrupts an active model call. The patch avoids widening retry behavior for side-effecting tool execution, so recovery does not silently replay operations that may have already touched external state.

## Origin / follow-up

N/A — independent downstream recovery classification hardening. Provider-boundary PRs such as #93965 are related to the original opencode-go stream outage, but this PR covers the generic downstream diagnostic recovery and failover-classification boundary.

## Competition / linked PR analysis

- **#93965:** Merged provider-owned opencode-go stream guard. It addresses the upstream provider stream boundary and formally closed the original issue.
- **#93640:** Earlier provider-scoped stream guard that overlaps the provider-boundary direction.
- **This PR:** Downstream embedded-run recovery safety. It fixes what happens after diagnostic stuck-session recovery aborts an active embedded run: `stuck_recovery` must survive the registry boundary, and replay safety must be classified before failover decides whether retry/fallback is allowed.
- **Why this can still land alongside a provider fix:** Even with provider-owned guards, the generic stuck-session recovery path still needs replay-safe semantics for model stalls, side-effecting tool stalls, and stale recovery.

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior or issue addressed:**
```text
Diagnostic stuck-session recovery must preserve `stuck_recovery` through the embedded-run and reply-run boundaries, then classify replay safety before failover observes abort semantics:
- active model-call stall with no active potential-side-effect tool => model_idle_timeout, eligible for the existing rotate/fallback path;
- active side-effecting tool stall => tool_execution_timeout, not idle timeout, so failover does not replay side effects;
- stale post-model / pre-model / unknown stuck recovery => external_abort, not a replay path.
```

- **Real environment tested:**
```text
Local OpenClaw PR worktree on Linux after merging current origin/main into the PR branch.
Worktree: /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-worktrees/pr-93655
Evidence directory: /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-pr-93655-evidence
Current PR HEAD: fbffbc2efd733cea57e8727599bf661bc0ad2302
Current origin/main: 04e4c3719de3c4e558fa62314861932d09e5778d

A local OpenClaw gateway was started from the same worktree with isolated OPENCLAW_HOME and loopback auth. The gateway reached ready state on 127.0.0.1:19001 using the local OpenClaw config, with logs written to the evidence directory.
```

- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**
```sh
cd /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-worktrees/pr-93655 && NO_COLOR=1 FORCE_COLOR=0 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-execution.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-memory.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/runs.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/stuck-recovery-abort.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.tools.test.ts src/logging/diagnostic-stuck-session-recovery.runtime.test.ts

cd /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-worktrees/pr-93655 && node --import tsx --input-type=module <production-module-runtime-probe>

cd /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-worktrees/pr-93655 && NO_COLOR=1 FORCE_COLOR=0 pnpm exec oxlint scripts/e2e/lib/openai-chat-tools/client.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-execution.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-memory.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/reply-run-registry.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/runs.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/runs.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run-state.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/stuck-recovery-abort.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/stuck-recovery-abort.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.tools.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.tools.test.ts src/flows/channel-setup.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts src/logging/diagnostic-stuck-session-recovery.runtime.ts src/logging/diagnostic-stuck-session-recovery.runtime.test.ts

cd /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-worktrees/pr-93655 && git diff --check
```

- **Evidence after fix:**
```text
Gateway readiness:
=== GATEWAY READY (33x2s) ===
[gateway] http server listening (8 plugins: acpx, browser, canvas, device-pair, file-transfer, memory-core, phone-control, talk-voice; 11.6s)
[gateway] ready
Control UI: http://127.0.0.1:19001

Production-module runtime proof:
{
  "head": "fbffbc2efd733cea57e8727599bf661bc0ad2302",
  "originMain": "04e4c3719de3c4e558fa62314861932d09e5778d",
  "classifications": {
    "modelCallStall": "model_idle_timeout",
    "sideEffectingToolStall": "tool_execution_timeout",
    "stalePostModelOrUnknownStall": "external_abort"
  },
  "abortAndDrain": {
    "aborted": true,
    "drained": true,
    "forceCleared": false
  },
  "observedAbortReasons": [
    "stuck_recovery"
  ],
  "replyRunFallback": {
    "aborted": true,
    "cancelReasons": [
      "stuck_recovery"
    ],
    "result": {
      "kind": "aborted",
      "code": "aborted_for_stuck_recovery"
    }
  }
}

Focused Vitest after the merge commit:
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  4 passed (4)
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  22 passed (22)
Test Files  2 passed (2)
Tests  264 passed (264)
Test Files  2 passed (2)
Tests  106 passed (106)
[test] passed 4 Vitest shards in 59.64s

changed-file oxlint: no output
git diff --check: no output
```

- **Observed result after fix:**
```text
The current-head production-module runtime probe observed the intended downstream behavior:
- model-call stuck recovery classified as model_idle_timeout;
- active side-effecting tool stuck recovery classified as tool_execution_timeout;
- stale or unknown stuck recovery classified as external_abort;
- abortAndDrainEmbeddedAgentRun forwarded abortReason=stuck_recovery to the active embedded-run handle and drained without force clear;
- reply-run abort propagation preserved stuck_recovery and produced aborted_for_stuck_recovery.

The focused tests also pass across reply-run fallback, stuck-recovery classifier/registry, active model-call lifecycle, active tool side-effect boundaries, and diagnostic recovery runtime on the merge-resolved HEAD.
```

- **What was not tested:**
```text
Unavailable external live proof: this run did not reproduce the intermittent live opencode-go cron outage and did not run a live opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash provider stream against opencode.ai under the reporter's provider account/config.

The fresh proof exercises the downstream OpenClaw diagnostic recovery and failover-classification boundary on the current PR head. Provider-owned stream termination behavior remains covered by provider-boundary PRs and is not claimed as live provider proof here.
```

- **Fix classification:** Root cause fix for the downstream diagnostic recovery / embedded-run failover classification boundary; complementary to provider-owned stream guard fixes.

## Review findings addressed

- **Replay-safety concern:** The runtime proof and focused tests show `stuck_recovery` is classified by active phase before failover observes abort semantics. Active model-call stalls can use model idle-timeout semantics; active side-effecting tool stalls remain tool-execution timeouts; stale/unknown recovery remains external-abort-like.
- **Current-main conflict:** The merge preserved current-main doctor health contribution mock exports while retaining the partial `agent-scope.js` mock needed to avoid non-isolated Vitest leakage.
- **Provider-boundary overlap:** This body keeps the external opencode-go provider proof boundary explicit and scopes this PR to downstream recovery classification.

## Regression Test Plan

- `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/stuck-recovery-abort.test.ts` covers the three stuck-recovery classifications.
- `src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.tools.test.ts` covers active side-effecting versus replay-safe tool counters.
- `src/logging/diagnostic-stuck-session-recovery.runtime.test.ts` covers diagnostic stuck-session recovery preserving `stuck_recovery`.
- `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/runs.test.ts` covers abort/drain and reply-run propagation.
- `src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-execution.test.ts` and `src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-memory.test.ts` cover reply-run fallback behavior around the downstream boundary.

## Risk / Compatibility

- **Risk labels considered:** session-state and availability.
- **Why acceptable:** The patch does not change provider wire format, model routing, public config, persisted schema, or fallback policy. It narrows abort semantics at the internal owner boundary where diagnostic recovery, embedded-run state, active model calls, and active tool replay-safety state are available.
- **Compatibility:** Existing `user_abort`, `restart`, and `superseded` semantics remain external-abort-like. The existing failover policy remains the source of truth for whether model idle timeouts rotate/fallback and for keeping tool-execution timeouts out of replay paths.

## What was not changed

- No provider stream parser changes.
- No opencode-go payload wrapper changes.
- No model routing, fallback selection, gateway protocol, or public config changes.
- No channel delivery or plugin contract changes.
- No persisted data model or migration changes.

## Root Cause

- **Root cause:** The source defect was an abort-classification contract violation between diagnostic stuck-session recovery and embedded attempt failover. Diagnostic recovery knew it was reclaiming a stale internal run, but downstream classification could lose the internal `stuck_recovery` reason or treat recovered stuck runs too broadly as model idle timeouts.
- **Why this is root-cause fix:** The fix preserves `stuck_recovery` through diagnostic abort/drain and reply-run propagation, then classifies replay safety from active model-call and active potential-side-effect tool state before failover observes abort semantics. That keeps model-call fallback available without replaying side-effecting tool work.
- **Scope boundary:** The root-cause boundary is attempt-local classification after diagnostic recovery aborts an active embedded run; provider parsing and failover policy are intentionally left unchanged.
